subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs (Governor-General - Policy followed) is correctly matched?

options.text: Marquis of Hastings - Followed fiscal conservatism

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Wellesley - Pursued imperialist conquests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Lord Wellesley served as the Governor-General of India from 1798 to 1805 and is best known for his aggressive imperialist policies.
 
• He introduced the **Subsidiary Alliance system**, under which Indian states were compelled to accept British forces and political influence in exchange for protection.
 
• The Subsidiary Alliance system helped expand British control over large parts of India, including Hyderabad, Mysore, and Awadh.
 
• During his tenure, the British defeated Tipu Sultan
